evidence: Module filtering works: clicking "API" shows only API documents, clicking "All" restores complete list. Each document displays its module label.
Document displays title, description, version, update date, content sections, and related documents. Verified with "Accessibility Standards" and "Component Library" documents.
Clicking reference link "Component Library" in expanded section navigated to that document. Link was clickable and opened the target document.
Clicking "Component Structure" section button collapsed it, hiding section body and reference links. [active] attribute state changed.
Clicking collapsed "Component Structure" section expanded it, restoring body paragraph and reference links. Content reappeared with [active] state.
Zoom In increased level from 100% to 120% with visible feedback. Reset View restored to 100%. Both operations showed button state [active] and zoom display updated.

Knowledge graph contains 19 nodes representing documents from all modules (API, Authentication, Data Layer, UI Components, Core System). Module legend shows all module associations. Graph displays connections between related documents.
Application has three distinct views: Documents (with list and detail panels), Knowledge Graph (with zoom controls and graph), and Favorites (visible as tab). All accessible via navigation buttons.

Content sections have clear expand/collapse indicators (icons and [active] attribute). Indicator state agrees with visibility: when [active], body and links visible; when not [active], body and links hidden.

Clicked REST API Design Guidelines node in Knowledge Graph. Switched to Documents tab and found that document was already displayed in detail panel, confirming it opened without tab change. State was preserved across tab switch.

Selected document (REST API Design Guidelines) remained displayed when switching between Documents, Knowledge Graph, and back to Documents tabs. Graph zoom state (100% to 120% to reset) was preserved across tab switches.

Clicked "API Versioning Strategy" link from collapsed REST Principles section: prompt "Please expand the section to access links" displayed, document remained open. After expanding section and clicking link again: API Versioning Strategy document opened successfully.

Favorites retained with real-time count (showed "1"), marker state changed to "Remove from favorites" immediately. Favorites tab displays favorited document. Marker survived navigation between tabs and persists in document list. Favorites count badge updated in real-time.

Verified multiple documents' related documents and content section references: REST API Design Guidelines references other API documents (not itself); Component Library references Design Tokens and Accessibility Standards (not itself); API Versioning Strategy references REST API Design Guidelines and Error Handling Standards (not itself).

Searched for "nonexistentdocument" which returned no results. Application displayed clear message: heading "No documents found" with paragraph "Try adjusting your search or filter criteria". Message appears when search criteria match no documents.

Knowledge graph contains 19 nodes representing all available documents across modules. Graph legend displays module associations: API, Authentication, Data Layer, UI Components, Core System. Nodes displayed for each document including "REST API Design Guidelines", "Component Library", "API Versioning Strategy" etc. Each node associated with document's module (visible in legend and node organization).
